text:
Maya (PM): Heads-up: were GAing the new hosted realtime endpoint today — /v3/realtime is live. This includes Tool-Calling v3 (structured calls + ordered execution) and two GA models: ember-lite and ember-pro. Docs and migration notes are at https://redwood.ai/docs/realtime-ga :tada:

Carlos (Eng): Awesome. Any client impact?

Maya (PM): SDKs must be bumped to >=1.13.0. Wire protocol changed — new chunk framing and JSON tool frames. Were providing a compatibility shim for a 30-day window for major customers.

release-bot: release pipeline started: realtime/v3 -> canary(us-central) -> global rollout. CI all green.

Anya (SRE): Ops checklist: rate limiter now enforces per-connection token caps. New metric: realtime.connection_latency_p50. If you see spike in 429s, set REALTIME_THROTTLE_GRACE=true to allow short bursts during migration.

Carlos (Eng): Do we change default fallback?

Maya (PM): Fallback policy: route -> ember-lite when ember-pro exceeds latency SLOs. Also added a quick-fallback flag customers can set in console.

Liam (Docs): I'll publish migration guide and example WebSocket snippets. Quick example (JS):

```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v3/realtime?model=ember-pro', {headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}`}});
ws.onmessage = (ev) => console.log(JSON.parse(ev.data));
ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'input', text:'Explain this design doc'}));
```

Maya (PM): Deprecation timeline: /v2/realtime will be deprecated for new sessions immediately; full shutdown planned 2026-09-30. Support will notify customers and offer migration assistance.

Anya (SRE): Monitoring: dashboards have been updated (dashboards/realtime-ga). Alerts: error-rate > 2.5% for 5m triggers P1. If canary regresses, we will halt rollout and rollback within 10m windows.

Carlos (Eng): Latency/cost expectations?

Maya (PM): Ember-pro aims for p50 ~15% faster for short-turn responses vs previous gen; cost per token similar to ember-lite when using kv cache. Recommend enabling kv_cache and batching_window=25ms for throughput workloads.

Liam (Docs): Links pushed: quickstart, migration guide, and API reference. Will add a troubleshooting section for toolcall deserialization edge-cases.

Maya (PM): Action items: Eng -> release SDK patch; Docs -> migration + examples; SRE -> monitor canary dashboards. Ping me for any customer exemptions. Thanks team :rocket:
